nodes.title: SG-1.4.2 · Render HeaderOverlay from App through the GameLayout header slot
nodes.body:
Context: HeaderOverlay exists (game/frontend/src/components/HeaderOverlay.tsx) with props worldTitle, round, loading, error, but App.tsx still renders RoundBadge and Countdown inside the scene and GameLayout has no header slot. Desired behavior: App fetches the current round, tracks loading and error, and passes a HeaderOverlay into a new GameLayout header slot. Expected result: the header shows round ID, status and countdown, or a loading or an explained error state, and the old RoundBadge and Countdown usage in App is gone. Why: the header must be a compact overlay with explained failure states.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given App is playing and getCurrentRound resolves, when it renders, then the header shows the round id, status and countdown from the HeaderOverlay.
- Given getCurrentRound is pending, when App renders, then the header shows 'Loading round…'.
- Given getCurrentRound rejects with an Error, when App renders, then the header alert shows 'Round unavailable: <message>'.
- Given App is playing, when it renders, then no standalone RoundBadge or Countdown element is rendered outside the header.


## Scope
- In scope: GameLayout header slot
- In scope: App round loading/error state and HeaderOverlay wiring
- In scope: Removal of RoundBadge and Countdown usage from App
- In scope: Unit tests with api client mocked
- Out of scope: Changing HeaderOverlay internals
- Out of scope: Backend or API changes
- Out of scope: Deleting RoundBadge.tsx or Countdown.tsx files
- Preserve: ContributionSheet flow
- Preserve: SceneView, ActionMenu and StoryPanel behavior
- Preserve: Existing drawer behavior of GameLayout


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript + Tailwind; use the existing getCurrentRound client and HeaderOverlay component
- Unit tests use vitest with dependencies mocked


## Definition of done
- All requirements implemented and unit tests green


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · GameLayout exposes an optional header slot
nodes.body:
Context: GameLayout takes only scene and story. Desired behavior: an optional header prop is rendered inside the relative main element before the scene so HeaderOverlay's absolute positioning anchors to the game area. Expected result: header content appears in main; omitting it changes nothing. Why: App needs to place the header without custom markup.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a header node is passed, when GameLayout renders, then the node is inside the main element together with the scene.
- Given no header prop, when GameLayout renders, then the layout renders as before with the scene and Story toggle.


## Scope
- In scope: GameLayout header prop
- Out of scope: Layout class changes
- Preserve: 80/20 grid, drawer toggle and overflow classes


## Technical constraints
- Prop must be optional


## Definition of done
- Header slot renders in main


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · App tracks round loading/error and renders HeaderOverlay in the header slot
nodes.body:
Context: App calls getCurrentRound and swallows errors. Desired behavior: track loading and error message state, render <HeaderOverlay worldTitle round loading error /> as the header prop. Expected result: loaded, loading and error states visible in header. Why: explain API failures instead of silent fallback.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the round resolves, then the header shows round id and status.
- Given the request is pending, then the header shows Loading round….
- Given the request rejects with Error('boom'), then the header alert shows 'Round unavailable: boom'.


## Scope
- In scope: App.tsx round state and header wiring
- Out of scope: HeaderOverlay changes
- Preserve: ContributionSheet roundId use
- Preserve: Intro gate


## Technical constraints
- Use getCurrentRound from api/client; world title from world in runtime/content


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Header wired with all states


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.body:
Context: App renders RoundBadge and Countdown inside the scene slot, duplicating the header. Desired behavior: remove those imports and JSX from App. Expected result: round status and countdown appear only once, in the header. Why: avoid duplicate round UI.

- Given the playing view, then exactly one element shows the round status and one countdown, both within the header.
- Given the source of App.tsx, then it does not import RoundBadge or Countdown.

- Out of scope: Their own tests
- Preserve: HeaderOverlay's internal Countdown use
